items.title: Minister Says Calling Border Land ‘Lost’ to Thailand is Treason
items.summary: A minister delegate to Prime Minister Hun Manet told pro-government media Wednesday that any Cambodian who describes the country as having “lost” territory to Thailand is committing treason.

items.title: CamboJA News Website Hit by Second Cyberattack This Year
items.summary: The English-language website of CamboJA News was hit Sunday by a cyberattack that flooded it with automated traffic. It was the second attack this year, adding to concerns about online threats to independent journalism.
